transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because I really need some help, Doctor. I've noticed that a specific group of people has been following me and monitoring my every move. I just feel incredibly anxious because I know they are watching me, and I don't know what they are planning to do to me.
Have you also been experiencing any significant changes in your mood, such as periods of feeling extremely high-spirited or unusually low and hopeless, that have lasted for several days or weeks?
No, I haven't really had any mood swings like that. My mood has been pretty stable, just very anxious because of the people watching me.

Aside from this belief about being watched, have you noticed any decline in your ability to take care of your daily responsibilities, like your work or personal hygiene, or have you found yourself feeling more withdrawn or less motivated to talk to others?

No, my daily routine, work, and hygiene are completely fine, and I'm managing all my responsibilities well. I don't feel unmotivated or withdrawn from others at all. I've just been a bit more cautious and avoidant in public places where I feel like I'm being watched.
